description: Resolve a held-object pose within the established placement zone. Configured XY is fixed. Otherwise propose centers of 4, then 8, then 16 subdivisions as needed: Decisions chooses an XY candidate ID before numerical Z search. Stop at the first feasible candidate. Keep the grasp orientation unless the task explicitly requires another supported orientation. Start Z at the hard clearance plus the recorded tracking reserve and raise only if necessary. Check held-object/gripper geometry, current collision world, offline workspace and fixed-orientation IK. Decisions chooses semantics and candidate IDs; it does not certify numerical safety. Whole-region choices are operation proposals, not high-confidence physical facts. Extra spatial clauses use current annotated candidate footprints. plan_place separately checks the three-phase trajectory. Unknown never silently selects an alternate configured XY. Geometry and region binding must precede grasping. Explicit capture_mode=fresh while holding only supplies current candidate images against valid geometry; it does not establish observed=true or repair a stale scene.
capability: Resolve a held-object pose within the established placement zone
